html:
A highlighted box for tips or warnings. Write a normal bullet list inside it.

Usage 

{{Callout|title=Tips|
* First tip.
* Second tip.
}}
  • title defaults to Tips. type uses the same colours as Template:Tl and defaults to reward (gold).
  • If the text contains an equals sign, write text= in front of it.
